messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Kicking off the billing service this week. @lead which database are we starting on?

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: We'll start the billing service on MySQL 8 since the team already knows it.

messages.speaker: builder
messages.text: I'll scaffold the schema migrations this afternoon.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Decision: we're switching the billing database from MySQL to PostgreSQL 16, because we need JSONB columns for invoice line items.

messages.speaker: builder
messages.text: Housekeeping note: the old MySQL dump scripts under tools/ are obsolete now and can be deleted.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Invoices are generated on the 1st of each month, in the customer's billing timezone.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Retry policy: failed charges are retried 3 times, 24 hours apart.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Change of plan on retries: retry failed charges 5 times, 12 hours apart. The old 3-times-every-24-hours policy lost us customers.

messages.speaker: builder
messages.text: Updating the retry job to 5 attempts at 12-hour spacing.

messages.speaker: human
messages.text: Project rule: every money amount is stored as integer cents, never as a float.

messages.speaker: lead
messages.text: Remember when we prototyped on MySQL? The collation problems alone justified moving off it.

messages.speaker: builder
messages.text: Someone asked whether the free tier could go back to 3 retries every 24 hours. No: 5 retries 12 hours apart applies to every tier.
